name: GB Corp.
author: Dr. Ludos; Peanut-GB by Mahyar Koshkouei
description: GB Corp. by Dr. Ludos, the Game Boy Competition 2021 version: a tiny office management game. Hire employees, level them up and make your company grow. MIT license (github.com/drludos/GBcorp).
